help.type: Holiday, Exam, Event, Meeting, Deadline or Make-up school day. Event to start with. When you change the type, the working-day tick changes too, unless you already touched the tick yourself.
help.name: The event's name, for example "Eid-ul-Fitr holiday".
help.startDate: The day the event starts. It must be inside the current academic year.
help.endDate: The day the event ends. For a one-day event, the same as the start date.
help.lateReason: Shows when the start date has passed and the day is a closed day. At least 3 characters, at most 500.
help.description: A short description of the event. Free text.
help.countsAsWorkingDay: If ticked, school runs that day. If not ticked, it is a closed day and attendance cannot be taken. For the Holiday type it starts unticked; for other types it is ticked.
help.publishImmediately: Only when adding. If ticked, everyone sees it. If not, it is a draft.
help.notify: If ticked, a notice goes to the people who can see the event.
help.alsoNotifyBySMS: An SMS goes to the guardians' phones too. It stays off unless the box above is ticked.
